name: Lavanya
text:
I visited this clinic for hair treatment. Before this, I had consulted several doctors for various health issues, but no one had ever taken so much time to patiently explain everything to me ,They listen carefully to patients concerns, understand their problems, and explain the treatment clearly. The cost is also reasonable, without any unnecessary extra expenses like in some other clinics.

They prescribe only the medicines that are actually needed and focus on improving overall health through lifestyle changes rather than relying only on medication.
Overall, I had a really good experience at this clinic .

name: Veluchamy K.
text:
I had a very positive experience at this dermatology clinic. Dr. Saranya was very patient, friendly, and professional, and took the time to understand my concerns properly. Her explanation of the condition and treatment was clear and reassuring.

The clinic staff were also courteous and helpful, and the overall experience was comfortable and pleasant. I truly appreciate Dr. Saranya’s care and attention and would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a good dermatologist.

name: Karthik A.
text: I consulted the doctor for my skin problem. The doctor explained my condition very clearly and patiently. The treatment was effective, and the medicines worked very well. I’m very satisfied with the improvement. Thank you, Doctor, for your excellent care and guidance! 🙏😊

name: Sridhar S.
text: I visited The Mirrors Dermatology Clinic for forehead hair loss treatment. After 2 months, I have started noticing some baby hair growth in the affected forehead area. I’m happy to see this initial progress and hopeful for further improvement. Thank you to the doctor and team for their guidance and support.

name: Aarvon B.
text: I had an excellent experience at this dermatology clinic. The doctor was professional, patient, and took the time to explain my skin condition and treatment options clearly. The staff were friendly, the clinic was clean and well-maintained, and the entire consultation process was smooth. I noticed a significant improvement after following the prescribed treatment. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality dermatological care.
